Minimal Workflow V2 现在变得更加极简了！

Update to better supportMoody Cutie Mix V4andMoody Krea2 Mix V7.

Moody Cutie Mix V4和 MoodyKrea2 Mix V7。

The Minimal Workflow just got even more minimal with V2!

This version is now completelynewbie-friendly—you don't need to install a single custom node to get it running. Just load it up and start generating!

It's the perfect way to get started, experiment, and see what Krea 2 can do without worrying about extra setup.

Hope you enjoy it, especially if you're new to ComfyUI! ❤️

Once you're a bit more experienced, I'd highly recommend trying myKrea 2 Simple Workflow, which includes more advanced optimizations and consistently delivers higher-quality results.

🎉

Krea 2 Simple Workflow

Moody Krea2 Mix

Moody Krea2 Minimal Workflow is Here! 🎉

After lots of requests, it's finally here! ✨

This workflow is designed to pair with myMoody Krea2 Mixmodel while keeping everything asminimal and cleanas possible. 🧩⚡ No unnecessary complexity—just the essentials to get you creating quickly.

As I become more familiar with Krea 2, I'll likely release a more advanced workflow with additional features and optimizations. 🔥

For now, enjoy the simplicity, experiment, and most importantly...

🎨 Have fun creating! 💙
